I seem to have forgotten, if I ever knew: does "usable by" mean
the same as "only usable by"?

Specifically, Echo of Harmonies at both [mel] and [MEL] says
"Usable by a ready vampire other than the acting minion." Is
it *also* usable by the acting minion, or *only* by a ready
vampire other than the acting minion?

thanks,

Josh

Messages.Body:
